svg.text: One reusable calibration + seven first spectral coefficients
Bcal = B(P,P); y_i = Bcal*y(P)/B(P+iG,P+iG+U). No C or c_Q input.
At most three x roots; two distinct candidates cannot agree at seven shifts (pole degree six).
Horizontal transport retains its derivative correction
C'/B' = F(C/B); B' = H B / F'(C/B). Require 2f(P) nonrational.
Actual P192 transfer -> supplied maps and explicit inverse
47 maps and closed duals; V = [degree^(-1) mod r] dual(f)(V_destination).
